Frequently asked questions

How many Sales Representative jobs are open in the United States?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 43 open Sales Representative jobs in the United States as of November 25, 2026.

How much do Sales Representative jobs in the United States pay?

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $70,000–$102,500 a year, based on 5 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.

Which employers are hiring for Sales Representative jobs in the United States?

Employers in this catalogue include Home Genius Exteriors (30 listings), SalesDraft Recruiting (3 listings), SpotOn (2 listings), Arizona Mixers Fresh Produce, LLC (1 listing), and Asset Data Collection Services L.L.C. (1 listing).

Is every listing fully remote from any state?

Check each listing; some remote jobs are limited to certain states or include location and worksite requirements. A remote label does not mean work from anywhere.
